rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: The White Doll isn't picking up any radiation.
rows.display_text:
（The White Doll isn't picking up any
radiation.）

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Even if this is Lost Mountain, it looks like there's nothing to worry about for now.
rows.display_text:
（Even if this is Lost Mountain, it looks
like there's nothing to worry about for
now.）

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Loran, are you all right!? Enemies incoming!
rows.display_text:
「Loran, are you all right!? Enemies
incoming!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Y-yes!
rows.display_text: 「Y-yes!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: What the...! The second we look away, treasure raiders show up.
rows.display_text:
「What the...! The second we look away,
treasure raiders show up.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Messing with our turf... you've got some nerve.
rows.display_text:
「Messing with our turf... you've got
some nerve.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: I don't know who you lot are, but it's your bad luck that we came back.
rows.display_text:
「I don't know who you lot are, but it's
your bad luck that we came back.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Consider this payback! Strip them of everything they've got!
rows.display_text:
「Consider this payback! Strip them of
everything they've got!」

rows.speaker: Miashei
rows.en: The nerve, saying whatever you want!
rows.display_text: 「The nerve, saying whatever you want!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: But we did come to the spot where they were digging, so I understand why they're angry.
rows.display_text:
「But we did come to the spot where
they were digging, so I understand why
they're angry.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Now that you mention it, you're right. I wonder if they'd understand if we explained the situation...
rows.display_text:
「Now that you mention it, you're right. I
wonder if they'd understand if we
explained the situation...」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: In any case, let's try calling out to them.
rows.display_text:
「In any case, let's try calling out to
them.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Please listen, Breaker! We have no intention of fighting you!
rows.display_text:
「Please listen, Breaker! We have no
intention of fighting you!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: N-no good! He's not listening at all!
rows.display_text: 「N-no good! He's not listening at all!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: What a fool. Even if you've got no fight in you, we've got plenty!
rows.display_text:
「What a fool. Even if you've got no
fight in you, we've got plenty!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Give it up, kid! You're already our prey!
rows.display_text:
「Give it up, kid! You're already our
prey!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: But...!

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: Enough, Loran! When trouble comes looking for you, you've got no choice but to swat it away!
rows.display_text:
「Enough, Loran! When trouble comes
looking for you, you've got no choice but
to swat it away!」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: Let's go, everyone! Horace is already clear. Now follow me!!
rows.display_text:
「Let's go, everyone! Horace is already
clear. Now follow me!!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Y-yes, sir!
rows.display_text: 「Y-yes, sir!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Captain Gavane seems awfully reliable today...
rows.display_text:
（Captain Gavane seems awfully reliable
today...）

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Th-this is bad...! Looks like we're the prey here!
rows.display_text:
「Th-this is bad...! Looks like we're the
prey here!」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: Loran! Look at the cargo on that Galapagos!!
rows.display_text:
「Loran! Look at the cargo on that
Galapagos!!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: That mark on the crate...!
rows.display_text: 「That mark on the crate...!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Nuclear...! Does that Breaker have a nuclear weapon!?
rows.display_text:
「Nuclear...! Does that Breaker have a
nuclear weapon!?」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: A nuclear weapon...? What's that...?
rows.display_text: 「A nuclear weapon...? What's that...?」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Desperate times call for desperate measures! Guess I'll just have to use the treasure!
rows.display_text:
「Desperate times call for desperate
measures! Guess I'll just have to use the
treasure!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Please stop! Do you even know what that is!?
rows.display_text:
「Please stop! Do you even know what
that is!?」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: I know it's a bomb, at least! I'll use this thing to finish you all off at once!
rows.display_text:
「I know it's a bomb, at least! I'll use
this thing to finish you all off at once!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: If you do that, you'll get blown away too!
rows.display_text:
「If you do that, you'll get blown away
too!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: You think I'm scared of a bluff like that!? Get ready!
rows.display_text:
「You think I'm scared of a bluff like
that!? Get ready!」

rows.speaker: Miashei
rows.en: What's he even talking about...?
rows.display_text: 「What's he even talking about...?」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: What's going on here, Loran!? Explain yourself!
rows.display_text:
「What's going on here, Loran!? Explain
yourself!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Explanations later! Miss, please get as far away as you can!!
rows.display_text:
「Explanations later! Miss, please get as
far away as you can!!」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: Huh...?

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: If the bomb he's holding goes off, it'll blow away this entire area!
rows.display_text:
「If the bomb he's holding goes off, it'll
blow away this entire area!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Ha ha ha! It's too late to surrender now!
rows.display_text:
「Ha ha ha! It's too late to surrender
now!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Here I come!! Regret standing against me in the next world!!
rows.display_text:
「Here I come!! Regret standing against
me in the next world!!」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: Like I'll let you!!
rows.display_text: 「Like I'll let you!!」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: Captain Gavane!
rows.display_text: 「Captain Gavane!」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: What are you planning to do!?
rows.display_text: 「What are you planning to do!?」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: I'll hold him down! Everyone else, run while you can!!
rows.display_text:
「I'll hold him down! Everyone else, run
while you can!!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Y-you...! Let go, let go of me!!
rows.display_text: 「Y-you...! Let go, let go of me!!」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: Like I'd let that happen! I've got a duty to protect Sochie!
rows.display_text:
「Like I'd let that happen! I've got a
duty to protect Sochie!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: That's reckless, Captain Gavane!
rows.display_text: 「That's reckless, Captain Gavane!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: If you do that, you'll get caught in the blast too, Captain!
rows.display_text:
「If you do that, you'll get caught in
the blast too, Captain!」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: I'll take his bomb before that happens! That way, everyone's safe, and I can finish the young master's request!
rows.display_text:
「I'll take his bomb before that happens!
That way, everyone's safe, and I can
finish the young master's request!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: That's not the point! That's a forbidden power!
rows.display_text:
「That's not the point! That's a
forbidden power!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: It'll spread poison for a hundred, two hundred years!
rows.display_text:
「It'll spread poison for a hundred, two
hundred years!」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: No good, Loran! Let's run!!
rows.display_text: 「No good, Loran! Let's run!!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Guooohhh! Screw it, I'll do it!!
rows.display_text: 「Guooohhh! Screw it, I'll do it!!」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: Captain Gavane!
rows.display_text: 「Captain Gavane!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: The White Doll is reacting to something...!? Now, of all times!
rows.display_text:
「The White Doll is reacting to
something...!? Now, of all times!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Something's coming up from underground!
rows.display_text: 「Something's coming up from underground!」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: What is that!?
rows.display_text: 「What is that!?」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: The nuke's going to explode! Everyone, run!!
rows.display_text:
「The nuke's going to explode! Everyone,
run!!」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: Did it... explode...?
rows.display_text: 「Did it... explode...?」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: What's going on!? The radiation reading vanished in an instant!
rows.display_text:
「What's going on!? The radiation reading
vanished in an instant!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Wh-what's with these faceless things!? Did they wreck my bomb?
rows.display_text:
「Wh-what's with these faceless things!?
Did they wreck my bomb?」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: That's... it's shaped just like the Overman we fought in Siberia, but...
rows.display_text:
「That's... it's shaped just like the
Overman we fought in Siberia, but...」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Wh-what is it...?
rows.display_text: 「Wh-what is it...?」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Is it looking toward Loran...?
rows.display_text: 「Is it looking toward Loran...?」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: Watch out, everyone! That faceless thing means to attack us!
rows.display_text:
「Watch out, everyone! That faceless
thing means to attack us!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: What the hell are these things!? I can't deal with this anymore!
rows.display_text:
「What the hell are these things!? I
can't deal with this anymore!」

rows.speaker: Miashei
rows.en: What is even happening!? Explain it, Joseph!
rows.display_text:
「What is even happening!? Explain it,
Joseph!」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: I don't know either! But if they came out of Lost Mountain, they're dangerous!
rows.display_text:
「I don't know either! But if they came
out of Lost Mountain, they're dangerous!」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: Form up! This isn't an enemy we can beat by fighting scattered!
rows.display_text:
「Form up! This isn't an enemy we can
beat by fighting scattered!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: No response, even when I call out... Is there no one piloting that Overman...?
rows.display_text:
「No response, even when I call out... Is
there no one piloting that Overman...?」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: Since they're the ones attacking, all we can do is meet them head-on!
rows.display_text:
「Since they're the ones attacking, all we
can do is meet them head-on!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: I've requested reinforcements from $c...! They say they'll arrive in one minute!
rows.display_text:
「I've requested reinforcements from
$c...! They say they'll arrive in one
minute!」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: So until then, we have to manage on our own...!
rows.display_text:
「So until then, we have to manage on
our own...!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: So this Overman is a relic of the Black History too, after all...
rows.display_text:
「So this Overman is a relic of the Black
History too, after all...」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Are you all right, $n!
rows.display_text: 「Are you all right, $n!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Yes! Somehow!
rows.display_text: 「Yes! Somehow!」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Are those things kin to the Overman we fought in Siberia?
rows.display_text:
「Are those things kin to the Overman we
fought in Siberia?」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: But it doesn't seem to be Sibe Rail. And it doesn't look like anyone's piloting it, either.
rows.display_text:
「But it doesn't seem to be Sibe Rail.
And it doesn't look like anyone's piloting
it, either.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Then what the hell is it!?
rows.display_text: 「Then what the hell is it!?」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: It's the ghost of Lost Mountain! There's no other way to put it!
rows.display_text:
「It's the ghost of Lost Mountain!
There's no other way to put it!」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: The ghost of Lost Mountain... a phantom of the Black History...
rows.display_text:
「The ghost of Lost Mountain... a phantom
of the Black History...」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: It can't be helped! All units, intercept the unidentified Overman!
rows.display_text:
「It can't be helped! All units, intercept
the unidentified Overman!」

rows.speaker: Meyrin
rows.en: Confirmed all Overmen destroyed. No reinforcements incoming.
rows.display_text:
「Confirmed all Overmen destroyed. No
reinforcements incoming.」

rows.speaker: Talia
rows.en: Just what was that...?
rows.display_text: 「Just what was that...?」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: Joseph... did that Overman emerge from this hole?
rows.display_text:
「Joseph... did that Overman emerge from
this hole?」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: Yeah, that's right. This is a forbidden place called Lost Mountain.
rows.display_text:
「Yeah, that's right. This is a forbidden
place called Lost Mountain.」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: We ended up setting foot in a place like that.
rows.display_text:
「We ended up setting foot in a place
like that.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: That Overman... it was clearly different from any we've fought before.
rows.display_text:
「That Overman... it was clearly different
from any we've fought before.」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: Yeah... an unmanned Overman attacking us like that...
rows.display_text:
「Yeah... an unmanned Overman attacking
us like that...」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: But if I had that power...
rows.display_text: （But if I had that power...）

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: What's wrong, Kihel Heim?
rows.display_text: 「What's wrong, Kihel Heim?」

rows.speaker: Kihel
rows.en: Lord Guin... just as Joseph said, this is a forbidden place.
rows.display_text:
「Lord Guin... just as Joseph said, this is
a forbidden place.」

rows.speaker: Kihel
rows.en: A black deeper than darkness... I believe that's a power people were never meant to hold.
rows.display_text:
「A black deeper than darkness... I
believe that's a power people were never
meant to hold.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Lady Kihel...
rows.display_text: 「Lady Kihel...」

rows.speaker: Kihel
rows.en: The Black History... a dark past sealed away in shadow...
rows.display_text:
（The Black History... a dark past sealed
away in shadow...）

rows.speaker: Kihel
rows.en: For people to take hold of that power can only lead to ruin...
rows.display_text:
（For people to take hold of that power
can only lead to ruin...）

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: Aside from restoring Luzianna, I've found myself a new goal!
rows.display_text:
「Aside from restoring Luzianna, I've
found myself a new goal!」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: For that, I can't afford to die! This fight... I'm going to survive it, together with Sochie!!
rows.display_text:
「For that, I can't afford to die! This
fight... I'm going to survive it, together
with Sochie!!」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: He's not joking, is he... Captain Gavane...
rows.display_text:
（He's not joking, is he... Captain
Gavane...）

rows.speaker: Miashei
rows.en: What's wrong, Sochie! You'll get hit if you space out!
rows.display_text:
「What's wrong, Sochie! You'll get hit if
you space out!」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: R-right!
rows.display_text: 「R-right!」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: Captain Gavane is serious...! Whatever I decide to say, I have to give him a real answer!
rows.display_text:
（Captain Gavane is serious...! Whatever I
decide to say, I have to give him a real
answer!）

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: So I can't afford to die either! I have to give it my all!!
rows.display_text:
「So I can't afford to die either! I have
to give it my all!!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: The White Doll knows that Overman...!
rows.display_text: 「The White Doll knows that Overman...!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: What does that mean...? That unit... unlike the others, is it some special kind of Overman!?
rows.display_text:
「What does that mean...? That unit...
unlike the others, is it some special kind
of Overman!?」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: That Overman has no one piloting it...!? Is it on autopilot!?
rows.display_text:
「That Overman has no one piloting it...!?
Is it on autopilot!?」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: An Overman that awoke from the ruins neutralizes radiation and attacks us...
rows.display_text:
「An Overman that awoke from the ruins
neutralizes radiation and attacks us...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Did all of this happen by pure chance...? Or...
rows.display_text:
「Did all of this happen by pure
chance...? Or...」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: ...A bandaged man?
rows.display_text: 「...A bandaged man?」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: While I was digging at a Mountain Cycle in southern Gallia, that man just suddenly appeared.
rows.display_text:
「While I was digging at a Mountain Cycle
in southern Gallia, that man just suddenly
appeared.」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: Then, to me as I stood there stunned, he said this.
rows.display_text:
「Then, to me as I stood there stunned,
he said this.」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: 'If you seek the truth, seek the history buried in darkness.'
rows.display_text:
「'If you seek the truth, seek the
history buried in darkness.'」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: History buried in darkness... the Black History, is it.
rows.display_text:
「History buried in darkness... the Black
History, is it.」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: In the Mountain Cycles we prospectors dig up...
rows.display_text:
「In the Mountain Cycles we prospectors
dig up...」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: ...lie relics of the age of great upheaval, what's called the Black History.
rows.display_text:
「...lie relics of the age of great
upheaval, what's called the Black History.」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: I don't know who that bandaged man is, but I agree with his words.
rows.display_text:
「I don't know who that bandaged man is,
but I agree with his words.」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: After all, I intend to obtain the power of the Black History and use it to reform society.
rows.display_text:
「After all, I intend to obtain the power
of the Black History and use it to reform
society.」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: I see...
rows.display_text: 「I see...」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: That's why I've sent you out as a survey team.
rows.display_text:
「That's why I've sent you out as a
survey team.」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: But the world is a vast place. Just searching around blindly won't turn up what you're after, young master.
rows.display_text:
「But the world is a vast place. Just
searching around blindly won't turn up
what you're after, young master.」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: I've been thinking about that too. I'm sorry, but for the time being, please continue the survey as it is.
rows.display_text:
「I've been thinking about that too. I'm
sorry, but for the time being, please
continue the survey as it is.」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: Understood. Well then, please give my regards to Joseph.
rows.display_text:
「Understood. Well then, please give my
regards to Joseph.」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: Relics of the Black History, is it...
rows.display_text: 「Relics of the Black History, is it...」

rows.speaker: Michael
rows.en: Young master, I've brought Horace and Joseph.
rows.display_text:
「Young master, I've brought Horace and
Joseph.」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: Well done, Colonel Michael.
rows.display_text: 「Well done, Colonel Michael.」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: So, what do you need from me and Horace, young master?
rows.display_text:
「So, what do you need from me and
Horace, young master?」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: I was just speaking with Sid a moment ago.
rows.display_text:
「I was just speaking with Sid a moment
ago.」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: How was he doing? Well... I doubt there's anything to worry about with Sid.
rows.display_text:
「How was he doing? Well... I doubt
there's anything to worry about with Sid.」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: Sounds like quite a struggle, but he seemed to be doing well. He asked me to give you his regards.
rows.display_text:
「Sounds like quite a struggle, but he
seemed to be doing well. He asked me to
give you his regards.」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: Joseph... you've served as Sid's assistant, and there's something I'd like to ask of you.
rows.display_text:
「Joseph... you've served as Sid's
assistant, and there's something I'd like
to ask of you.」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: Ask...?

rows.speaker: Horace
rows.en: Does this concern me as well?
rows.display_text: 「Does this concern me as well?」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: Yes, Horace. Your abilities will be needed too.
rows.display_text:
「Yes, Horace. Your abilities will be
needed too.」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: Joseph, Horace... I'd like to ask the two of you to survey the Mountain Cycle in this area.
rows.display_text:
「Joseph, Horace... I'd like to ask the
two of you to survey the Mountain Cycle
in this area.」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: ...So this is a Mountain Cycle.
rows.display_text: 「...So this is a Mountain Cycle.」

rows.speaker: Miashei
rows.en: Huh... it feels completely different from the Heim Mine in Vicinity.
rows.display_text:
「Huh... it feels completely different from
the Heim Mine in Vicinity.」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: There's a real presence to this place... solemn, I guess, or maybe imposing...
rows.display_text:
「There's a real presence to this place...
solemn, I guess, or maybe imposing...」

rows.speaker: Horace
rows.en: Mountain Cycles exist all over the world, but they come in many different forms.
rows.display_text:
「Mountain Cycles exist all over the
world, but they come in many different
forms.」

rows.speaker: Horace
rows.en: As a member of the Dianna Counter, I've surveyed several myself, but this is my first time seeing this type.
rows.display_text:
「As a member of the Dianna Counter,
I've surveyed several myself, but this is
my first time seeing this type.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: It has a strange atmosphere. The word 'ruins' seems to suit it.
rows.display_text:
「It has a strange atmosphere. The word
'ruins' seems to suit it.」

rows.speaker: Horace
rows.en: The common theory is that Mountain Cycles are places where relics of the great upheaval lie sleeping, but...
rows.display_text:
「The common theory is that Mountain
Cycles are places where relics of the
great upheaval lie sleeping, but...」

rows.speaker: Horace
rows.en: I believe there's a reason these excavation sites are concentrated in one place like this.
rows.display_text:
「I believe there's a reason these
excavation sites are concentrated in one
place like this.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: And that would be...?
rows.display_text: 「And that would be...?」

rows.speaker: Horace
rows.en: Many of the relics don't seem to simply be sleeping in the earth -- I believe they were gathered here under some specific intent.
rows.display_text:
「Many relics don't seem to simply sleep
in the earth -- I believe they were
gathered here for a specific purpose.」

rows.speaker: Horace
rows.en: In other words, I suspect the Mountain Cycle itself is the remains of some facility that is itself a relic of the great upheaval.
rows.display_text:
「In other words, I suspect the Mountain
Cycle itself is the remains of a facility
-- itself a relic of the great upheaval.」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: Does it have anything to do with the fact that this is covered in snow, even though it's in western Gallia?
rows.display_text:
「Does it have anything to do with the
fact that this is covered in snow, even
though it's in western Gallia?」

rows.speaker: Horace
rows.en: I can't say for certain about that, but it's definitely an unnatural situation.
rows.display_text:
「I can't say for certain about that, but
it's definitely an unnatural situation.」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: Sorry about this, $n. Dragging you along for the young master's personal errand.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry about this, $n. Dragging you
along for the young master's personal
errand.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Please don't worry about it. I'm off duty right now anyway.
rows.display_text:
「Please don't worry about it. I'm off
duty right now anyway.」

rows.speaker: Miashei
rows.en: In $n's case, that free time all goes into training anyway.
rows.display_text:
「In $n's case, that free time all goes
into training anyway.」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: That's why we dragged them along, even if we had to force it.
rows.display_text:
「That's why we dragged them along, even
if we had to force it.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Thank you, Sochie, Miashei. This should be a nice change of pace.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you, Sochie, Miashei. This should
be a nice change of pace.」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: But we definitely didn't come here just to play.
rows.display_text:
「But we definitely didn't come here just
to play.」

rows.speaker: Miashei
rows.en: That's true. If we find a unit like the White Doll, it'll add to $c's fighting strength.
rows.display_text:
「That's true. If we find a unit like the
White Doll, it'll add to $c's fighting
strength.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: But this place... it looks like it's already been dug up...
rows.display_text:
「But this place... it looks like it's
already been dug up...」

rows.speaker: Horace
rows.en: Hmm... judging by the look of things, excavation seems to have taken place quite recently.
rows.display_text:
「Hmm... judging by the look of things,
excavation seems to have taken place
quite recently.」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: Still, a mission's a mission. Let's begin surveying the area.
rows.display_text:
「Still, a mission's a mission. Let's begin
surveying the area.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: How's it going, Joseph? Think you'll find anything?
rows.display_text:
「How's it going, Joseph? Think you'll find
anything?」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Joseph...?
rows.display_text: 「Joseph...?」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: Loran... this isn't just an ordinary Mountain Cycle...
rows.display_text:
「Loran... this isn't just an ordinary
Mountain Cycle...」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: What do you mean?
rows.display_text: 「What do you mean?」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: This might be Lost Mountain... the place they call the forbidden land.
rows.display_text:
「This might be Lost Mountain... the place
they call the forbidden land.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: The forbidden land...?
rows.display_text: 「The forbidden land...?」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: Sid told me about it over and over... anyone who sets foot in Lost Mountain doesn't come back alive.
rows.display_text:
「Sid told me about it over and over...
anyone who sets foot in Lost Mountain
doesn't come back alive.」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: In fact, a prospector Sid knew apparently lost his life after digging in Lost Mountain.
rows.display_text:
「In fact, a prospector Sid knew
apparently lost his life after digging in
Lost Mountain.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: But... how do you know this is that Lost Mountain?
rows.display_text:
「But... how do you know this is that
Lost Mountain?」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: Look, this is the sign of it.
rows.display_text: 「Look, this is the sign of it.」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: I was told never to set foot anywhere with this mark on it...
rows.display_text:
「I was told never to set foot anywhere
with this mark on it...」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: This is... a nuclear symbol...!
rows.display_text: （This is... a nuclear symbol...!）

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: ...The sun's gone and set on us.
rows.display_text: 「...The sun's gone and set on us.」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: Should we head back for now? It's cold out here.
rows.display_text:
「Should we head back for now? It's cold
out here.」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: Here, put my jacket on, Sochie.
rows.display_text: 「Here, put my jacket on, Sochie.」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: Eh... but...

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: Feels kind of like I'm proposing... doesn't it?
rows.display_text:
「Feels kind of like I'm proposing...
doesn't it?」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: Eh... y-yes... That's awfully sudden.
rows.display_text: 「Eh... y-yes... That's awfully sudden.」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: These days everything happens all of a sudden. Dimensional shifts, enemies showing up, falling in love, life coming to an end...
rows.display_text:
「These days everything happens all of a
sudden. Dimensional shifts, enemies
appearing, falling in love, life ending...」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: So I don't want to have any regrets.
rows.display_text: 「So I don't want to have any regrets.」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: But, I...
rows.display_text: 「But, I...」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: You don't have to say anything. I haven't properly proposed yet, anyway.
rows.display_text:
「You don't have to say anything. I
haven't properly proposed yet, anyway.」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: But once this fight is over...
rows.display_text: 「But once this fight is over...」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: An explosion! Is someone attacking us!?
rows.display_text: 「An explosion! Is someone attacking us!?」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: Seems like we weren't the only ones after this Mountain Cycle!
rows.display_text:
「Seems like we weren't the only ones
after this Mountain Cycle!」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: We're linking up with Loran and the others! Follow me!
rows.display_text:
「We're linking up with Loran and the
others! Follow me!」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: Y-yes, sir!
rows.display_text: 「Y-yes, sir!」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: You want me to head to Siberia?
rows.display_text: 「You want me to head to Siberia?」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: Yes... Among all the relics of the Black History, the existence of the Overman is something noteworthy in particular.
rows.display_text:
「Yes... Among all the relics of the Black
History, the existence of the Overman is
something noteworthy in particular.」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: For the sake of that investigation, I'd like you to head to Siberia.
rows.display_text:
「For the sake of that investigation, I'd
like you to head to Siberia.」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: But even if you say that, Siberia is a big place too...
rows.display_text:
「But even if you say that, Siberia is a
big place too...」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: I'm well aware of that. Which is why I've already decided on the specific place for you to go.
rows.display_text:
「I'm well aware of that. Which is why
I've already decided on the specific place
for you to go.」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: And that would be?
rows.display_text: 「And that would be?」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: Wulgusk.
rows.display_text: 「Wulgusk.」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: The dome city where Gainer and the others lived?
rows.display_text:
「The dome city where Gainer and the
others lived?」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: That's right. I'm also sending Colonel Michael and a Moonrace engineer there.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. I'm also sending Colonel
Michael and a Moonrace engineer there.」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: After you join up with them, please make your way to Wulgusk while surveying various sites along the route.
rows.display_text:
「After you join up with them, please
make your way to Wulgusk while surveying
various sites along the route.」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: Understood.
rows.display_text: 「Understood.」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: Depending on the situation, you may end up meeting with the lord of Wulgusk as my envoy.
rows.display_text:
「Depending on the situation, you may end
up meeting with the lord of Wulgusk as
my envoy.」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: The lord of Wulgusk, Duke Medaiyu, is a collector known as the 'Art Duke'...
rows.display_text:
「The lord of Wulgusk, Duke Medaiyu, is a
collector known as the 'Art Duke'...」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: I hear Gainer's Overman was one of his possessions too.
rows.display_text:
「I hear Gainer's Overman was one of his
possessions too.」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: Is something bothering you?
rows.display_text: 「Is something bothering you?」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: ...As a prospector, I've surveyed all sorts of Mountain Cycles up until now, but...
rows.display_text:
「...As a prospector, I've surveyed all
sorts of Mountain Cycles up until now,
but...」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: There are times I feel afraid of what I've been doing.
rows.display_text:
「There are times I feel afraid of what
I've been doing.」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: Do you mean the place called Lost Mountain?
rows.display_text:
「Do you mean the place called Lost
Mountain?」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: So you heard from Joseph... That's certainly part of the fear I feel, yes.
rows.display_text:
「So you heard from Joseph... That's
certainly part of the fear I feel, yes.」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: Part...?
rows.display_text: 「Part...?」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: We use relics from the past without even knowing their meaning...
rows.display_text:
「We use relics from the past without
even knowing their meaning...」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: Among them are surely forbidden things people should never touch, like Lost Mountain, and yet out of ignorance we just chase after power...
rows.display_text:
「Some, like Lost Mountain, are forbidden
things we should never touch, yet in our
ignorance we just chase power...」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: Someday, a day may come when we pay a heavy price for it.
rows.display_text:
「Someday, a day may come when we pay
a heavy price for it.」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: Are you trying to say I'm a fool?
rows.display_text: 「Are you trying to say I'm a fool?」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: N-no, that's not what I meant, but...
rows.display_text: 「N-no, that's not what I meant, but...」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: Rest assured, Sid. I act in order to reform society for the better.
rows.display_text:
「Rest assured, Sid. I act in order to
reform society for the better.」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: I intend to use the relics of the Black History and the strength of $c toward that end as well.
rows.display_text:
「I intend to use the relics of the Black
History and the strength of $c toward
that end as well.」

rows.speaker: Sid
rows.en: Young master...
rows.display_text: 「Young master...」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: I'll be waiting for good news, Sid. Please become a strength for me, and for this world.
rows.display_text:
「I'll be waiting for good news, Sid.
Please become a strength for me, and for
this world.」
